properties.name: composes
properties.description: CSS Modules: adds the listed classes to this one, from this file or another module (`composes: a b from "./other.module.css"`).

pseudoClasses.name: :global
pseudoClasses.description: CSS Modules: keeps the selector unscoped, as in `:global(.dark) .title`, or switches the rest of the selector to global.

pseudoClasses.name: :local
pseudoClasses.description: CSS Modules: scopes the selector to this module. It's the default, so it only matters after `:global`.
